description.zh:
是否返回已经互通的实例：

- true（默认）：返回的实例列表中包括已经互通的实例。
- false：返回的实例列表中不包括已经互通的实例。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return instances that are already connected. Valid values:

- true (default): The returned instance list includes instances that are already connected.
- false: The returned instance list does not include instances that are already connected.

title.zh: 获取网络互通实例列表
title.en: Retrieve private network peering instance list

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch describe-connectable-clusters --instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --already-set-items true --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
